title: Crossroads C&I
content:
Crossroads C&I is a Canadian distributor and fabricator serving commercial, industrial, and marine insulation markets. The company supplies aerogel materials and fabricated fitting solutions through a multi-branch network across Canada.

  • Coverage Area: Canada
  • Focus Areas: Commercial insulation, industrial insulation, marine insulation, custom fitting fabrication, and aerogel pipe insulation systems
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®) and other insulation system manufacturers
  • Official Website: https://crossroadsci.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
